SPECIFICATION FOR 

WOODEN CARD STAVES SET WITH PINS FOR CYLINDRICAL 

DRUM ROLLERS OF JUTE CARDING MACHINE 



1. Scope — Prescribes the requirements for wooden card staves set with pins for use in jute carding 
machine. 

1.1 The wooden card staves set with pins are used with cylinder, feed, fjeed stripper, worker, worker 
stripper and doffer in jute carding machine. 

2. Material 

2.1 Wooden Sfai^es — Wooden staves conforming to 15:7034-1973 'Specification for wooden staves 
used for drum rollers of jute carding machines' shall be used. If required by the purchaser, the staves 
may be steel faced by using 1*25 mm ( 18 gauge ) thick CRCA sheet [see IS : 513-1986 Specification 
for cold rolled low carbon steel sheets and strips ( third revision ) ] free from rust, or aluminium faced 
by using 2 mm (14 gauge) thick aluminium sheet [see IS; 737-1986 Specification for wrought 
aluminium and aluminium alloys, sheet and strips (for general engineering purposes) {tliird 
revision ) ], as may be agreed to between the buyer and the seller. 

2.2 Card Pins — Pins conforming to IS : 4909-1968 'Specification for card and gill pins for use in jute 
industry' shall be used. However, the details would be as agreed to between the buyer and the 
seller. 

3. Requirenfients 

3.1 Nominai — The nominal dimensions shall be as agreed to between the buyer and the seller. 
However, in case there is no agreement these shall be as declared by the manufacturer. 

3.1.1 Tolerance — The dimensions shall be subject to the following tolerances: 

Dimension Tolerances 

Number of pins per row ± 3 ( see Note 1 ) 



Screw hole pitch, mm 
Angle of pins, degree 
Pin height, mm (see Note 2 ) 



±ro 

±3 
±08 



Note 1 — This requirement is not applicable to rows where screw holes appear and the adjacent rows. 
Note 2 — This requirement is recommendatory and Is given for guidance only. 

4. Marking — Each card stave set with pins shall be legibly marked with the manufacturer's name or 
trade-mark. 

4.1 Standard Marfiing — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

5. Packing — Card staves set with pins shall be suitably packed so as to provide complete protection 
to pin from any damage. 

6. Sampling and Criteria for Conformity — Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and 
the seller to ascertain the conformity of wooden card staves set with pins to the requirements of this 
specification, single sampling plan with Inspection Level Tend Acceptance Quality level (AQL) of 
2*5 percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS :2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables: Part 1 
Inspection by attributes and by count of defects ( first revision Y shall be followed.

EXPLA N A TORY NOTE 

The card staves set with pins are firmly attached to cylindrical drum rollers of carding machine 
by stout screws. The size and pitch of pins in a roller mainly depends on the function of roller, the 
type of jute to be processed, the quantity of feed and the count of yarn to be produced. The 
requirements of pins and staves are given in IS : 4909*1968 and IS : 7034-1973. respectively. 

This standard has been formulated with a view to provide guidance to the manufacturers and 
users of wooden card staves set with pins for cylindrical drum rollers of Jute carding machine. It is 
hoped it would ensure manufacture of this product of acceptable quality leading to the improved 
functioning of the carding machine.
